typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblSLACPCIDData_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		legalFullName as string,
		legalParent as string,
		busAExtlStatC as string,
		busAExtlKeyCLegal as string,
		busAN as string,
		busAExtlSystemC as string,
		legalSysARelC as string,
		busAExtlN as string,
		busAIdC as string,
		loadDate as timestamp,
		legalIdC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblCIDData
tblCIDData sink(input(
		legalFullName as string,
		legalParent as string,
		busAExtlStatC as string,
		busAExtlKeyCLegal as string,
		busAN as string,
		busAExtlSystemC as string,
		legalSysARelC as string,
		busAExtlN as string,
		busAIdC as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		legalIdC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		legalFullName,
		legalParent,
		busAExtlStatC,
		busAExtlKeyCLegal,
		busAN,
		busAExtlSystemC,
		legalSysARelC,
		busAExtlN,
		busAIdC,
		loadDate,
		legalIdC),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblSLACPCIDData_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblSLACPCIDData
